positions.assessment: Icarus Attack needs a Winged Beast Tribute. Vata must stay for the Black-Winged Dragon line. Sudri and Simoon have both used their effects. Simoon's Lv6 is more useful as Synchro material than Sudri's Lv4, and Vata plus Simoon also makes a Lv8 Synchro. Tributing Sudri is the cheapest choice. Tributing Simoon is playable but gives up the bigger body.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Sudri has used its search, and keeping Simoon (Lv6) and Vata keeps the strongest Synchro and BWD routes.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Simoon has done its job too, but the Lv6 body is worth more than Sudri's Lv4, and the token it cites isn't needed when Vata is already a Tuner.

grades.label: C
grades.reason: The same Tribute as A, and its reasoning about Vata and the Lv6 Simoon is correct.

positions.assessment: Boreastorm needs to become Lv2 so that Boreastorm (2) plus BWD (8) makes Full Armor Master. The Lv2 candidates are Chinook, Harmattan and Vata. BWD will be banished for Assault Dragon, which leaves Vata's main effect dead. Vata is also the card in the Deck whose draw is worth least. Chinook is a Quick Effect and Harmattan is a one-of extender, so both are better left in the Deck.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: The Lv2 and the line are right, but it sends away Chinook, which is a useful interaction card, when Vata is worth less.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Vata becomes the weakest card once BWD is gone, and it still sets Boreastorm to Lv2 for the Full Armor Master and Assault Dragon line.

grades.label: C
grades.reason: The Level works, but Harmattan is a one-of extender and is worth more than a Vata with no BWD to summon.

positions.assessment: Armor Master attacks our own Assault Dragon, which the opponent holds through Crackdown. It can't be destroyed and we take no battle damage. After the damage step it can put a Wedge Counter on that monster. Full Armor Master hasn't used its once-per-turn steal, so in Main Phase 2 it can take control of the countered Dragon and get it back. This is a clear yes.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Placing the Wedge Counter lets Full Armor Master take Assault Dragon back in Main Phase 2.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: It overlooks that the Wedge Counter enables Full Armor Master's control-taking effect. That forfeits a free recovery of Assault Dragon.
